name: Hiyohiyo Hiyoko
source:
Tokyo, 2019. In Akihabara there is a maid cafe run by girls themselves. 

Sweat and tears,  courage and justice, romance and passion, violence & action! 

New crisis awaits mysterious beauties every day!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2019年，东京。秋叶原有一家由女孩们自己经营的女仆咖啡馆。

汗水与泪水、勇气与正义、浪漫与激情、暴力与行动！

新的危机每天都在等待着神秘的美女！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
